chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ḥātim narrated from Muḥammad ibn Jaʿfar, from Aḥmad ibn Buṭṭah al-Qummī, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn, from Muḥammad ibn Sinān, from al-Mufaḍḍal ibn ʿUmar, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, that he said:

He performs an additional one thousand rakʿahs in the month of Ramadan. He said: I said, “And who is able to do that?” He said: “It is not as you think. Do you not perform in the month of Ramadan an additional one thousand rakʿahs? In nineteen nights of it, in every night twenty rakʿahs; and on the night of the nineteenth, one hundred rakʿahs; and on the night of the twenty-first, one hundred rakʿahs; and on the night of the twenty-third, one hundred rakʿahs; and you perform in eight nights of it during the last ten, thirty rakʿahs. So these are nine hundred and twenty rakʿahs.”

He said: I said, “May Allah make me your ransom, you have relieved me. The matter had indeed become constricted for me, but when you brought the explanation, you relieved me. So how is the completion of the one thousand rakʿahs?” He said: “You perform on every Friday in the month of Ramadan four rakʿahs for Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام, and you perform two rakʿahs for the daughter of Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, and after the two rakʿahs you perform four rakʿahs for Jaʿfar al-Ṭayyār عليه السلام. And you perform on the night of Friday during the last ten, for Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام, twenty rakʿahs, and you perform on Friday evening, the night of Saturday, twenty rakʿahs for the daughter of Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم.”
Then he said: “Listen, retain it, and teach it to the trustworthy ones among your believing brothers.” And he continued the hadith.

key_terms.أَلْفِ رَكْعَةٍ: one thousand rakʿahs of supererogatory prayer
key_terms.أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام, for whom specific prayers are designated
key_terms.ابْنَةِ مُحَمَّدٍ: the daughter of Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, for whom specific prayers are designated
key_terms.الْعَشْرِ الْأَوَاخِرِ: the last ten nights of Ramadan, during which additional prayers increase
key_terms.ثِقَاتِ إِخْوَانِكَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: the trustworthy believing brothers who are to be taught this hadith
key_terms.جَعْفَرٍ الطَّيَّارِ: Jaʿfar al-Ṭayyār عليه السلام, for whom specific prayers are designated
key_terms.شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ: the month of Ramadan, the period in which these additional prayers are performed
key_terms.لَيْلَةِ تِسْعَ عَشْرَةَ: the nineteenth night of Ramadan, assigned a special prayer count

ai.seo_question: How are the additional one thousand rakʿahs of prayer in the month of Ramadan calculated in al-Istibṣār?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the recommended additional prayers in the month of Ramadan and clarifies how their total reaches one thousand rakʿahs. It details a structured devotional program across the month, including special prayers on particular nights and Fridays, and concludes with an instruction to preserve and teach this knowledge to trustworthy believers.
